description: Get the daily visibility score history of one application. The visibility score (0-100) summarises how discoverable the app is across its tracked keywords. Returns app_id, app_title, the resolved from/to dates, and history[] of { date (YYYY-MM-DD), score }, where score is null on days with no snapshot. Defaults to the last 30 days. The window is capped at 400 days and at the plan history depth: a start date beyond it returns a PLAN_LIMIT error. Reversed dates are swapped and future dates are clamped to today. Pass the numeric internal ID from list_applications, not the store bundle ID. For one keyword rank over time, use get_keyword_rank_history.

app_id.description: The application internal ID (numeric, e.g. "344" from list_applications results)

from.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to 30 days ago.

to.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to today.

name: get_app_score_history
